editorial.blurb: Chef Stephanie Izard's inventive Chinese-American kitchen delivers bold, complex flavors and impeccable hospitality in a beautifully designed room that feels like dining in a friend's home.
editorial.insiderTip: Request a reservation well in advance and ask your server to time courses for optimal pacing; the staff excels at managing the multi-course experience, and birthdays receive special treatment with personalized cards and house-made ice cream.
